issues.description: Method name mismatch for the meal-cost calculation: the problem statement (UML) declares a method named calculateTotalPrice(Meal) and also requires this method to be static. The solution implementation defines a static method named computeMealCost(Meal) in SealSaloon, while the solution's Main calls calculateTotalPrice(...) (a method that does not exist). The template's commented Main calls computeMealCost(...). This inconsistent naming across problem statement, solution class, and example usage will confuse students and, as shown in the solution, causes a compilation error because Main refers to a method name not present in SealSaloon.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the method name consistent across all artifacts. Either: (A) Rename SealSaloon.computeMealCost(Meal) to calculateTotalPrice(Meal) (keep it static as required) and update all call sites (solution Main and any template/example code) to call calculateTotalPrice, or (B) Update the problem statement/UML to require computeMealCost(Meal) instead of calculateTotalPrice and state its static requirement accordingly. After choosing one name, update all example code and the SealSaloon implementation so that declaration and calls match exactly.
